body: Is it just the content-type header that is missing? What is in `$_SERVER` for you?
HTTP_AUTHORIZATION is also often missing from $_SERVER on some apache servers.
I'm curious what changes in the request from dispatch filter -> controller, and how/where the header value becomes populated.

The issue I stated for `HTTP_AUTHORIZATION` might be unrelated to the one reported by @ionas. `$_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']` is known to be never populated on some apache servers depending on server version/config and one needs to use `getallheaders() / apache_request_headers()` to get the particular value.
Ok. CakePHP doesn't use `getallheaders()` as it is SAPI dependent. Instead we look in `$_SERVER` for both `CONTENT_TYPE` and `HTTP_CONTENT_TYPE`. What is in `$_SERVER` ?

``` php
<?php
namespace App\Routing\Filter;

use Cake\Event\Event;
use Cake\Network\Exception\BadRequestException;
use Cake\Routing\DispatcherFilter;

class JsonInputFilter extends DispatcherFilter
{

    /**
     * Before dispatch callback.
     *
     * @param \Cake\Event\Event $event The beforeDispatch event.
     * @return void
     */
    public function beforeDispatch(Event $e)
    {
        \Cake\Log\Log::write(LOG_DEBUG, $_SERVER);
        // Get HTTP headers, case insensitive:
        $headers = getallheaders();
        foreach ($headers as $key => $value) {
            unset($headers[$key]);
            $headers[strtolower($key)] = $value;
        }
        // Check for JSON content-type:
        if (isset($headers['content-type']) === false) {
            return;
        }
        if (strpos($headers['content-type'], 'application/json') === false) {
            return;
        }
        // JSON header has been set, JSON body is expected to exist:
        if (empty($e->data['request']->input())) {
            throw new BadRequestException('JSON HTTP-body missing.');
        }
        $jsonHttpBody = json_decode($e->data['request']->input(), true);
        if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
            throw new BadRequestException('Invalid JSON HTTP-body given: ' . json_last_error_msg() . '.');
        }
        $e->data['request']->data = $jsonHttpBody;
    }
}
```

function testApi(id) {
    var body = document.getElementById(id).value
    var request = new XMLHttpRequest();
    request.onreadystatechange = function() {
        if (request.readyState == XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
            console.log(request.responseText);
            document.getElementById(id + 'Output').innerHTML = request.responseText;
        }
    }
    request.open('PUT', '/api/v1/validate.json');
    request.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    request.send(body);
    return false;
}
